══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
⚡ EasyDash Unified Antigravity CLI & Open WebUI Command Manual
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ANTIGRAVITY CLI COMMANDS:
/goal <prompt>    Run long-running autonomous task with extra thoroughness
/plan <task>      Analyze task with step-by-step planning before execution
/grill-me [topic] Interactive interview to resolve design ambiguities
/boost <task>     Deep multi-perspective reasoning mode with verification
/browser <query>  Browser automation, web exploration & interactive testing
/teamwork-preview Orchestrate a team of autonomous subagents
/learn <rule>     Persist learned instructions or rules for future tasks
/schedule <time>  Schedule recurring cron job or set one-time timer
/compress         Compress session conversation history to free context window
/effort [level]   Set reasoning effort: low, medium, high
/mode [mode]      Set agent execution mode: plan, accept-edits
/continue, /c     Continue previous Antigravity session turn (-c)
/agy <prompt>     Execute Antigravity CLI with options

PROVIDERS & LLM COMMANDS:
/lmstudio         Switch active provider to LM Studio (:1234)
/ollama           Switch active provider to Ollama (:11434)
/model [name]     Show or switch active LLM model
/models           List downloaded models or open Model Manager
/pull <name>      Pull model from Ollama registry with progress bar
/search <query>   Zero-key live web search grounding (DuckDuckGo Lite)
/scrape <url>     Fetch and summarize clean URL article text
/engine [name]    Switch provider: agy, lmstudio, ollama, openai, powershell
/preset [name]    Load persona: sre, devops, powershell, coder, raw
/system [prompt]  View or update custom system prompt

HOMELAB & TERMINAL COMMANDS:
/ps <cmd>         Execute PowerShell command on host (!<cmd>)
/pipe [text]      Load text into stdin buffer (/pipe clear)
<cmd1> | <cmd2>   Pipe output of command 1 into command 2!
/nodes            Query Proxmox cluster nodes and latency
/services         Display status of all homelab services
/ping <url>       Measure round-trip latency to URL
/history          Display past command history
/export [md|json] Download current session transcript
/theme [name]     Set terminal theme: dark, oled, retro, amber, matrix
/new              Start fresh chat conversation
/clear (Ctrl+L)   Clear current session output buffer
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
KEYBOARD SHORTCUTS:
↑ / ↓             Autocomplete menu selection (or history navigation)
Tab / Enter       Accept slash command auto-complete
Ctrl+B            Toggle left chat history sidebar
Ctrl+L            Clear terminal screen
Ctrl+C            Abort active command / generation
Shift+Enter       Insert newline without executing
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
